span.p:
Connect AI: API keys, plan sign-in or installed agent, local model
Pick folder · Git set up or dirty work snapshotted

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: How would you like to start?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: All five at once · examples folded

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: One at a time · example open

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What are you building? Who needs it and why?
Walk through one use. What must the demo prove?
Which choices are fixed or delegated?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Always-enabled text or dictation
One answer can cover multiple topics

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local transcript only · pauses never submit
Graph updates once, after Send

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sequenced, versioned user turn
Record author, spans, focus and retractions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Existing project: inspect pinned repo and tests
Record observations separately from desired behavior

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Opening review proposes supported answers and domains
Actor, action and observable result can establish a workflow

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Code selects from shared and domain question indexes
Filter by prerequisites; score additional uncovered criteria
Rescore after each pick, up to five; use 2–3 for a small change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No suitable entry: derive one scoped project question
Require a concrete gap, rubric and remaining budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Small resolver proposes one value per criterion
Only relevant turns, rule and current premises

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate current source, quote, meaning and inference rule
Unresolved siblings and delegated-but-unchosen values stay open

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Focused question queue · one concrete gap or conflict
Explain, offer options or free text, keep the same question ID

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Code records supported facts and their dependencies
Correcting one rechecks the claims that used it

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exact scoped decisions resolved, inherited prerequisites met,
no critical gaps, completeness pass finished?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicit milestone deferral needs an independent interface
Show overall detail and which consumers remain blocked

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Repeated gap or exhausted budget:
show the blocker and wait for new evidence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Construct architecture nodes and typed links
Requirements, contracts, UI, edge cases, tests and ownership

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Planner proposes master plan → feature → task → optional child
Pin behavior, interfaces, paths, steps, UI states and selected skills

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Planner pins visible examples before implementation; oracle-author
writes held-back cases for rule logic; verify red-before-green

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Coordinator is code · sole writer to canonical SQLite state
Validate authority, lease, relevant node and edge versions, budgets

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Atomic revision: graph, briefs, audit and outbox
Export versioned Markdown, JSON and readable Mermaid views

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Plan preview: Phase 0, tasks, crew, cost and time
First build waits for Start build; small revisions may auto-start

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Spec expansion: matrices, every cell with a basis
Contradictions checked by code, then model

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Risk-triggered research · quotes verified
Feature details produced one wave ahead

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Task prerequisites, human steps, authority,
budget and compatible contract versions ready?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Record reason and owner · wait only affected work

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Phase 0 foundation first, then feature waves
Crew size and model level computed per wave; reserve resources and lease

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Isolated attempt in an OS sandbox: worktree, ports, no direct internet
Compiled knowledge packet in; artifact, versions and checks out

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Static audit: no stubs, TODOs, swallowed errors,
hard-coded data or test tampering

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Missing context goes to original task author or successor
Fetch verified handoff or queue a real product question

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Independent verifier runs protected expectations
on a clean candidate with fresh fixtures and current lease

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Feature integrator (the plan author's role) squashes passing tasks
One wiring task wires real entry points; combined user journey runs

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Project merge queue checks current target
Accept result and release dependents only on verified success

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attribute failure and route to its owner
Bound repairs and stop on repeated failure

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bounded lookup in two linked graphs
Small model proposes target and intent; code checks current ownership

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Read-only progress or rationale · cite receipts, no work change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
New or changed feature · owner compares plausible meanings
Trace contract consumers: hold definite, quarantine possible,
continue unaffected; preserve all independent hold reasons

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Execution control · validate target and lease
Stop button bypasses the model

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Restart: reconcile leases, outbox, pending costs and effects
Unknown external outcome is reconciled before any retry

svg.text: Coding harness — from a spoken idea to an independently verified feature
